content_sections.heading: Andhra University Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance

rows.details: Department of Computer Science & Systems Engineering, A.U. College of Engineering (A), Andhra University, Visakhapatnam
QUEST: Quantum Enhanced WRF model for Urban Climate System Modelling
3 years or the closure of project whichever is earlier (renewed every year subject to satisfactory performance)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech. (or equivalent) and ME/M.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or allied disciplines. Applicants require a minimum of 75% marks or 7.5 CPI/CGPA with no backlogs attempts in both B.E./B.Tech. and ME/M.Tech. Candidates must have knowledge of Quantum Computing/Algorithms and hands-on experience with Qiskit. A valid UGC NET/Gate score is desirable.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected Junior Research Fellows will receive a fellowship of 37,000/- per month plus HRA as per norms. The appointment is temporary for a tenure of 3 years or until the project closes, whichever is earlier, and will be renewed annually based on satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Andhra University Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Prepare your resume with all relevant copies of certificates. Send your application and attachments via email to the Member Investigator at [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches the specified email address on or before 23/10/2026 by 5 PM. Keep all original certificates ready to present if you are called for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated in due course of time to attend an interview along with all original certificates. No TA and DA will be paid to attend the interview.

rows.date: To be intimated to shortlisted candidates in due course of time

faq.question: Q1. Is the Junior Research Fellow position permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The position is temporary, with a tenure of 3 years or until the project closes, whichever is earlier. It is renewed every year subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any allowances paid in addition to the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates receive a fellowship of 37,000/- per month plus HRA as per norms.

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: Having knowledge of Quantum Computing/Algorithms, hands-on experience with Qiskit, and a valid UGC NET/GATE score are desirable qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the position?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on their resumes and certificates, and shortlisted individuals will be called for an interview with all original certificates.
